title: Microsoft security advisory (AV26-1001)
description: As of October 2, 2026, Microsoft is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
Microsoft Exchange Server 2016 Cumulative Update 23
	Prior to 15.01.2507.075

Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 Cumulative Update 14
	Prior to 15.02.1544.048

Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 Cumulative Update 15
	Prior to 15.02.1748.053

Microsoft Exchange Server Subscription Edition RTM
	Prior to 15.02.2562.053
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
